summary: Backend regression after AI-count caption UI fix (iter 19). Verified draft upsert + is_draft + sisa_pagi/sisa_siang on POST/GET /api/{production,warehouse}/daily, and reachability of AI endpoint. All 11 new tests + 33 existing regression tests (produksi_gudang, discrepancy, new_features) PASS = 44/44 (100%). Frontend skipped per request (camera not automatable). One doc discrepancy: review says AI route is /api/production/daily/ai-count but actual route is /api/ai/count-gallons — frontend uses correct one.

minor.issue: Review request referenced endpoint as POST /api/production/daily/ai-count but actual server route is POST /api/ai/count-gallons (server.py:2815). Not a bug — just doc mismatch. Frontend PhotoCapture.tsx must be pointed at the correct URL.

TestProductionDraft: Draft upsert: second POST with same (sales,date,shift,is_draft) UPDATES same id (produksi_galon 20→35, only 1 row in list)
is_draft=False on a different shift INSERTs a new row
TestWarehouseDraft: POST /api/warehouse/daily is_draft=True with photo_isi_pagi + sisa_pagi persisted
GET draft for non-matching date returns {} (empty object)
TestAiCountReachable: POST /api/ai/count-gallons with token but missing image_base64 → 422
POST /api/ai/count-gallons with token + empty string → route reachable (not 404)

regression_suites (33 PASS).test_produksi_gudang.py: 18/18 — production/warehouse daily CRUD, edit-once limit, monthly report auto-fill
regression_suites (33 PASS).test_new_features.py: 9/9 — expense photo edit, GPS filter, settings RBAC, reset guards, create-user without google_email

action_items: (Doc-only) Update review-request wording so it matches the actual AI endpoint POST /api/ai/count-gallons; the frontend already targets the correct URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Draft upsert in server.py:2413-2429 and 2541-2557 uses find_one + update_one — safe for single-writer but not fully atomic under concurrent posts. Consider find_one_and_update with upsert=True if the same (sales,date,shift) can be posted from two devices at once. Not blocking.
sisa_pagi / sisa_siang are now present on both ProductionDailyCreate (server.py:2192-2193) and WarehouseDailyCreate models — confirmed via response payload.
Server.py is 3107 lines — monolithic; not blocking but worth splitting into modules (auth, production, warehouse, reports, ai).
seed_data_creation: Tests write to isolated past date 2020-02-19 for sales A1; per-module autouse fixture wipes production_daily + warehouse_daily rows for that (sales,date) before + after the class runs, keeping the DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest backend/tests/test_ai_draft_iter19.py backend/tests/test_produksi_gudang.py backend/tests/test_discrepancy.py backend/tests/test_new_features.py -v -o addopts=''. All 44 tests must remain green. AI endpoint is POST /api/ai/count-gallons (NOT /api/production/daily/ai-count).
rca_of_issue: n/a — this iteration is a UI-cosmetic fix (Ionicons-based caption replacing emoji + PhotoMeta status label). Backend was not modified; only regression verification was requested. All requested endpoints (draft POST/GET, sisa_pagi/sisa_siang in response, photo_rumah, AI reachability) verified functional.
